d:
Mokama ke vidhayak anant sinh ki beti ki shadi ke avsar par aayojit ghoron ki daur (hors res) shuru ho gaee hai. daur shuru hote hi aayojan sthal aur uske aaspas ka najara dekhne layak ban gaya.
Anant sinh ki beti ki shadi men ho rahi is ghoron ki daur ko dekhne ke lie hajaron ki sankhya men log pahunche hain. maidan aur aaspas ke kshetron men darshakon ki bhari bhir najar aa rahi hai, jisse pure ilake men khasi chahal-pahal bani huee hai. is vidiyo men dekhie anant sinh ki beti ki shadi men shuru huee ghoron ki daur aur umri bhir ki riporta.
